mediaCheck.title: Camera & Microphone Check
settings.title: Settings
settings.cloudEnvironmentDescription: Selects the Microsoft cloud endpoint. Choose Custom to enter your own URL.
settings.connectionUrlDescription: The URL loaded on startup. Automatically set by the environment above.
settings.userAgentDescription: Sent with HTTP requests and reflected in navigator.userAgentData. Only change this if a tenant needs a different Edge/Windows version — clear the field to reset to the built-in default.
settings.clearSessionDescription: Clears all stored cookies, cache, and local storage. You will need to log in again.
settings.clearSessionConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all cookies and cache? You will need to log in again.
settings.clearSessionDone: Cookies and cache cleared. The portal will reload.
settings.restartNotice: Saved. Restart the app for all changes to take effect.
